accountId.description: The account; the environment's default account when absent.

path.description: The directory on the environment's machine.

oneOf.description: A directory the environment has; the harness never makes, moves or removes it outside a workspace root.

path.description: The worktree's directory, which the environment chose and made.

repository.description: The main checkout (or bare repository) the worktree was made from.

branch.description: The branch the worktree was made on; not read again when a run switches branch.

oneOf.description: A git worktree the environment made from a repository it has.

path.description: The scratch directory, under the data directory's scratch root.

oneOf.description: A scratch directory the environment made for the session that asked for it.

anyOf.description: A workspace of a kind a later environment records: read as a directory at its path.

kind.description: A kind this version does not know.

path.description: An absolute path as the environment's operating system writes it: from /, a drive (C:\) or a share (\\).

workspace.description: Where a session's code lives on its environment: a directory, a worktree or a scratch directory, each with an absolute path. A kind a client does not know reads as a directory at its path.
